Seed 011 targets retry counter codec boundary (u16 encode/decode). The codec is a trivially invertible u16↔bytes mapping; cargo-fuzz (VLD-vb-y9d3v-0087, PO-vb-y9d3v-0041) provides exhaustive coverage against arbitrary byte sequences with ASAN. Verus round-trip proofs add no coverage not already provided by the fuzz+ASAN campaign for this simple codec.

Seed 011 retry counter codec is a trivially invertible u16↔bytes codec. Kani bounded model checking adds no coverage over cargo-fuzz+ASAN (PO-vb-y9d3v-0041) for this simple encode/decode path. The retry counter bounds are already covered by seed 003 Kani obligations (PO-0009).

Seed 011 targets a trivial u16 codec boundary. Flux type refinements for u16 bounds are already covered by seed 009 obligation PO-0035. The codec-specific encode/decode path is adequately verified by cargo-fuzz+ASAN (PO-0041) without requiring additional Flux annotations.

Seed 011 targets a trivial u16 codec boundary. proptest property testing for u16 roundtrip adds no coverage beyond cargo-fuzz+ASAN (PO-0041) which exercises the same encode/decode path with arbitrary bytes and ASAN memory checking.
